name: 7 Wonders
description: Draft cards over three ages to build a city and a wonder. Leaders, Cities and the Wonder Pack are switchable add-ons. Private local build: not for distribution.

leaders.title: Leaders expansion
leaders.description: Leader draft, recruiting each age, 6 starting coins, Rome, 4 guilds.

leaderPromos.title: Leaders goodies: Louis, Stevie, Esteban
leaderPromos.description: Adds the three promo leaders to the Leaders pool (needs Leaders).

cities.title: Cities expansion
cities.description: Black cards, debt, diplomacy, Petra and Byzantium, 3 guilds; allows 8 players (deal 7, play 6, set up like 7).

teamPlay.title: Cities team play
teamPlay.description: 4, 6 or 8 players in adjacent pairs: teammates do not fight, conflict tokens are doubled (needs Cities).

wonderPack.title: Wonder Pack
wonderPack.description: The Great Wall, Stonehenge, Manneken Pis, and Abu Simbel (with Leaders).

sideB.title: Play the B side of every wonder
sideB.description: Otherwise every wonder is on its A side.

randomSides.title: Random wonder sides
randomSides.description: Each wonder's side is drawn at random (overrides the B side option).
